guard/30382.htm.text: Guard Leikan: If you follow this road northeast, you will come to the Ruins of Agony. Originally, it was the village of Bernice, where I was born, but it was reduced to ashes by the war. If you see its ghastly state, you will understand why it's now called the Ruins of Agony. If you pass the ruins …

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30382-1.htm.text: Guard Leikan: The Ruins of Agony used to be a vineyard. It was a beautiful, peaceful place where they tended grapevines and olive trees. However, the village was burnt by the Gracian army, led by ol mahum mercenaries, and most of the people were slaughtered. Recently, the lord sent engineers to the…

guard/30382-2.htm.text: Guard Leikan: It is a vast forest to the northeast in Oren and is the headquarters of the Dark Elves. They have a deep-rooted feud against the Elves of light, and so the two enemies have come to blows on occasion, but now they have signed a peace agreement. I shudder when I look at the Dark Elves, …

guard/30382-3.htm.text: Guard Leikan: When the war broke out, the people who were unable to escape to Gludio Castle all flocked to the village of Bernice. They thought they could withstand the attack of the invaders because the village had a stone outer wall. The lord's men, who suffered retreat after retreat, positioned …

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30382-02.htm.text: Guard Leikan: At one time the land northwest of Gludio was fertile farmland, yielding bountiful harvests of wheat and barley. During the dark days of the invasion of Gracia, when the farmers were in hiding, the land was taken over by the filthy Turek orcs. Some day, my people will drive them out an…

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30382-01.htm.text: Guard Leikan: At one time the land northwest of Gludio was fertile farmland, yielding bountiful harvests of wheat and barley. During the dark days of the invasion of Gracia, when the farmers were in hiding, the land was taken over by the filthy Turek orcs. Some day, my people will drive them out an…

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30382-04.html.text: Guard Leikan: You must hurry and take this letter to Piotur . His farm is near the east entrance of the Orc Barracks . I pray that you are able to recover the lands for the farmers of Gludio.

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30382-05.html.text: Guard Leikan: Ah, you again! How was Piotur? By the way, in case you're interested, I've heard that some relics from the ancient empire have been discovered near the Orc Barracks. You could make quite a bit of money selling those.

links.text: "Tell me about the relics from the ancient empire."

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30382-01.html.text: Guard Leikan: Ha ha! Welcome. So Arkenia sent you. What can your humble servant do for you?

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30382-03.htm.text: Guard Leikan: Excellent. Take this letter to Farmer Piotur . He is bravely tending his crops while being overrun by filthy orcs. His farm is near the east entrance of the Orc Barracks .

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30382-05a.html.text: Guard Leikan: Bear in mind that this is a rumor, I've not seen it myself. I was told that mercenaries have been seen returning from the area near the Orc Barracks with relics from the Elmo-Aden period. Although they are little more than pottery shards, they fetch a high price. If you are interested…

links.text: "Where can I find a relics expert?"

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30382-05b.html.text: Guard Leikan: I know that Trader Asha is an expert in the restoration of relics. He can be found at his magic store. Magister Iris is researching relics of ancient empires at the temple... Also, Trader Nestle is an avid collector of relics. He can be found at the grocery store in the southwest part…

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30382-02.html.text: Guard Leikan: The thieves that stole your race's treasures? Ah ... I do know roughly where they live, but ... I could tell you, but there is one condition. If you accept one request, I will give you information on the thieves. Please don't think I am stingy. A man must do something to survive. Noth…

links.text: Do not have time to accept his request

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30382-03.html.text: Guard Leikan: Actually, I recently boasted to my colleagues that I was attacked by Moonstone beasts while returning from the Dark Forest, and that I killed several. My colleagues didn't believe me and asked to see proof. This put me in a rather ... awkward position. So you see, I need ten Moonstone…

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30382-04.html.text: Guard Leikan: If you don't want to grant my request, I cannot give you information on the thieves. I don't do business that doesn't earn a reasonable profit.
